engine.cause: MET-C16 (ac3b0cedd) routed the baseline vc check through a new off() helper that rounds 'mine' to 2 decimals before comparing with a 0.0011 tolerance, while vc is a 3-decimal share. 0.356 becomes 0.36, a difference of 0.004, so the check fails whenever the live baseline's third decimal is not near 0 ('vc 0.356 vs 0.356').
